release_notes: Reworked Morsewurst telemetry so key down/up events are now handled in real time instead of waiting for a completed tone before sending and processing telemetry.
Straight key input now reports the key-down event immediately when the key is pressed and the key-up event when it is released, allowing the application to react while the key is still held down.

Iambic keyer telemetry now follows the keyer-generated element stream: each dit or dah is reported when the element starts and when it ends, while preserving the existing iambic timing, spacing and Mode A / Mode B behaviour.
Raw telemetry display has been improved so active input is shown immediately and continues to update while a key or generated element is still in progress.

Completed tone data used by decoding, scoring and timing analysis is now derived from the same V1 down/up telemetry stream, preserving microsecond-level timing accuracy for t0, t1 and duration values.
Improved network transmission and playback so Morse input can be relayed from the key-down moment instead of waiting until the full element has finished.
Updated network receive playback, jitter-buffer handling and live tone scheduling so repeated straight-key presses and iambic elements are reproduced correctly as a real-time stream.
Improved telemetry debug output and debug snapshots so raw key events, active down/up state and derived tone events are recorded and inspected more clearly.
Added and updated regression tests for V1 key telemetry normalization, derived tone creation, network key-message handling, jitter-buffer playback and live tone rendering.
Morsewurst Keyer firmware must be updated to version 1.1 for this release. The updated firmware file is available at https://kasperikoski.fi/morsewurst as morsewurst_keyer_1_1.ino.
Includes general cleanup around the telemetry architecture and related test organization without changing the public V1 telemetry version.
